scope: Short nonblocking stack-only observation of the already-running public proof.
sampling_semantics: 10Hz Python stack snapshots including idle/waiting threads; not native CPU attribution or a whole-request performance measurement. Nonblocking collection can miss or race frames. No locals, no native stacks and no signals that pause target execution requested.
target_overhead: Profiler wall/child CPU cost is measured below; perturbation of the running target is not separately measured, so these are not calibration timings.
